_comment: Tests that run on one operating system only. tests/run-all.sh reads this list:
on the other system it does not run the test and prints it as SKIPPED with its reason.
Each entry: path (a discovered test, repository-relative), only (linux or macos), and
reason (one line naming the construct that ties it to that system, and the task that ports it).
An entry that names no discovered test, repeats a path or carries no reason fails the run.
A port that makes a test pass on both systems deletes its entry in the same commit.

tests.reason: the tap-to-solve share drives Xvfb, x11vnc and websockify and reads /proc/net/tcp; X11 screen sharing is not on macOS (F13 plan section 4)

verifies the systemd units with systemd-analyze, which macOS does not have; the launchd jobs are tested on both systems by systemd/agent-session.test.py (every *.plist.example) and adding-an-agent/plists.test.py (this skill's [launchd] blocks)
